$schema_note: Curated smoke selection for `make run-provider-harness-test SMOKE=1`. Rows are matched by (folder, name) against the AUGMENTED collection (tmp/harness-augmented.json), because the cache-parity rows are generated at augment time and do not exist in provider-harness.json. `folder` is the immediate parent folder and is REQUIRED, not advisory: the criss-cross rows are named after their model, so a bare name like `gemini/gemini-2.5-flash` matches 25 requests. Selecting a request pulls in its chained-variable producers automatically (filter-collection.mjs expandWithProducers), so the effective request count can exceed the count here. Rows claimed by more than one provider partition run once per fork, same as in a full sweep.

pillars.intent: Prompt-cache read/write parity. Round 34 is the direct-vs-Bifrost anchor (a Bifrost leg reading materially less than the direct leg on identical bytes means a dropped breakpoint); Round 35 is one model per provider; folders 41 and 13 cover content-block cache_control / cachePoint placement. These rows match every provider fork, so the harness replays them in one sequential pass after the parallel run.
